snippet.title: Find the Anomalous Robot in this Horror game! - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Request access to playtest right now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3583330/Robot_Anomaly/

In "Robot anomaly" your job is to inspect all produced robots. Deal with unauthorized hardware modifications and rogue behavior. And escape the building! You are the only human there, but you are not alone.
